headline: Trump proposes an 'AI Force' and renames AI 'super intelligence'
summary: President Trump said he will create an 'AI Force' and appoint an AI czar to oversee AI development, offering few details on what the unit would do. He dismissed AI safety concerns as a Democratic hoax. Days later, at the UN General Assembly, he said the US is 'officially' renaming artificial intelligence to 'super intelligence,' though experts doubt the term will catch on.
